headline: 45 of 45 rehearsal runs passed
detail: 25 of 25 single-fault runs named the right cause; the rest are the honesty scenarios of beat 7.
method: Each scenario is injected once into the live lab; the agents start 90 s after the first alert and run independently. A run passes when its primary cause is in the accepted set (graded by code, not by a model). Cost is the API-equivalent price Claude Code reports per run.
